title: Robust Bash Script Skeleton (usage, logging, error trap, dry-run)
description: A clean starting point for any new script: long/short option parsing, a --help screen, timestamped logging, an error trap that reports the exact failing line, and an optional --dry-run flag. Start every new script from this instead of a blank file.

variables.name: SCRIPT_PURPOSE
variables.prompt: One-line description of what this script does (shown in --help)
variables.default: Describe what this script does here.

variables.name: AUTHOR_NAME
variables.prompt: Author / team name to note in the header

variables.name: LOG_FILE_PATH
variables.prompt: Log file path (only used if you choose stdout + file logging below)
